description: Cofounder is an agent-native operating system for running a company, spanning engineering, sales, marketing, finance, and operations. Its product includes a web app plus hosted agent interfaces for programmatic access.
summary: Cofounder exposes three declared integration surfaces on cofounder.co subdomains: a hosted OAuth-protected MCP server at `api.superoptimizers.cofounder.co/mcp`, an Agent-First HTTP API at `api.superoptimizers.cofounder.co/cofounder-cli/v1`, and the `cofounder` CLI distributed via npm.
